label: At D1, candidate drops after an unrewarded S2 outcome, most after a2 reaching S2 unrewarded.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0)
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 40 is saturated by phase (about +0.9 at D1, -1 at GO, +1 at D2; timing explains 0.99 of variance); all residual magnitude lives at D1, where it declines late in the episode. Beyond timing, D1 value drops sharply after the previous trial was a2 -> S2 unrewarded (about -0.3), less after any unrewarded S2 outcome (a1 S2 u), and rises slightly with belief that S1 is good (belief_lo). GO and D2 carry no history information. The free fit adds the trial before: repeated unrewarded trials, especially a streak of a2 choices without reward, push D1 further down (to about -1.4 in examples), and a rewarded previous trial raises it; this accumulating a2-failure history is what the 3-term short form misses. No future variables used.
